thread:
tess.recruiter: Quick question  candidate for Support Lead (IC3) needs to shift start due to visa. Wants earlier onboarding for shadowing 2024-08-10 but payroll start 2024-09-01. Also asking for $4k relocation + $3k sign-on. Any objections to paying relocation prior to payroll?
ryan.peopleops: Relocation payment pre-pay is allowed if invoiced (reimbursement) and receipts provided; direct payroll payments pre on-boarding are limited. We can make an exception if it's reimbursements to vendor (moving company) paid by company card.
meera.hiringmgr: Candidate wants funds wired to cover temporary housing before payroll. Would company wire directly to housing provider?
kate.finance: Company payments to vendors OK if vendor invoices company directly. Wiring to candidate personal account before payroll is risky. We prefer vendor invoicing or hold reimbursement on payroll after 09-01.
tess.recruiter: Candidate prefers vendor pay. We'll ask vendor for invoicing. Also how to handle benefits and PTO accrual during shadow period?
ryan.peopleops: Benefits and PTO accrual follow payroll start date (09-01) per policy. Shadowing before payroll is unpaid volunteer time unless we set up a contractor agreement. That's messy for visa. Best to have them do unpaid project prep or vendor paid services.
meera.hiringmgr: Ok we'll request vendor invoice for temporary housing and schedule shadowing as voluntary sessions. Candidate is comfortable with that.
hr-bot: Reminder: any relocation > $5k requires pre-approval from Comp Committee and tax education for candidate.
kate.finance: Since relocation is $4k, no committee needed. But include repayment clause if leaves <12 months.
tess.recruiter: Will add repayment clause and vendor invoice requirement. Will update offer draft.
ryan.peopleops: I'll flag for onboarding team to prepare a conditional start checklist documenting unpaid shadowing and vendor payment. Keep thread updated if vendor can't invoice directly.
meera.hiringmgr: Thanks, wrapping this up today.
